name: Armor of the Serpent
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 min./level

DESCRIPTION

Your skin transforms to snake scales, granting you a natural armor bonus to AC equal to +2 for every three caster levels, up to a maximum of +10 at 15th level. These scales replace the normal texture of your skin rather than hardening it, and does not stack with existing natural armor bonuses you may have.
